implementationRules: Create real Unity6 source under isolated estate-only scripts (e.g. BraxEstateR2RoadNetwork.cs) and reuse one Brax controller.
Survey exact scene mesh/bounds/door transforms in actual build; x sign flips in Unity import; do not blindly paste proposed coordinates.
Create actual road/sidewalk/curb meshes with correct UVs, mesh colliders and interpolated junction geometry; never rely on decals alone.
Keep 553 original estate mesh inventory and every existing door/portal, no building movement.
Only apply surfaces after SHA/licensing/UV verification of source map.
Build expansion terrain and ground collision up to proposed envelope; do not obstruct buildings and entry triggers.
No new buildings, cars, NPCs, mission logic or combat in this phase.
No main/production changes, no cross-workstream file merges.
Capture 15% actual Unity6 before/after PNG and 20–40 second authentic MP4 with one walk; then finish all roads.
Final prove no collision/z-fighting/missing UV and real Brax walk between house, civic, park, sport, loop and return portal.
